_comment: template.json — the two things about this invitation that are NOT copy: its
background music, and the microcopy on its gesture chips.
THE INVITATION COPY IS NOT HERE. Every readable string — names, dates, venues,
family lines, dress codes, the invocation, RSVP — lives in data/textspec.json,
generated from the client's PSDs by tools/extract_text.py and typeset as live HTML
over the artwork by js/fx/text.js. That file is the single source of both the copy
and its geometry; nothing may retype a string out of it.
The `text` and `zones` blocks that used to sit here were placeholder scaffolding
from before the PSD text was extracted. They are gone. js/stage.js still carries
the slot builder that read them (buildTextSlots + ctx.text) — with no `text` key it
returns null and builds nothing, and js/fx/text.js creates the .scene-text overlay
itself. TODO(production): that dead builder, css/stage.css's `.slot` rules and
ctx.text() can be dropped whenever the engine is next opened for edit.
hints: the microcopy on each scene's gesture chip, keyed by scene slug. Read by
js/fx/kit.js (NOT by the text machinery — these are chrome, not invitation copy).
An empty or missing string renders the gesture mark with no pill at all, so a scene
can be muted here without touching its module. Keep each line to about 30
characters: past that the pill wraps to a second line and starts covering artwork.
Every scene takes the same gesture — a single tap — so every line says tap.
music.src: the background track. js/audio.js creates the <audio> lazily inside
the FIRST user gesture — the tap on the curtain intro — so a guest who never
opens the invitation pays nothing for it, and the nav's mute toggle stays hidden
entirely while this string is empty.
hints.intro is the one chip NOT drawn by js/fx/kit.js: the curtain overlay lives
outside .scene__frame, so js/intro.js reads this key itself and paints its own
pill in the same visual language (css/intro.css).
hints.last: the finale's fountain now also turns the page, to the venue map (2026-09-22).
map: the venue map slide (js/scenes/map.js). embed is Google's keyless /maps/embed
(the page the classic ?output=embed URL redirects to); directions opens Google Maps
turn-by-turn on phones. The query is the venue's listed name and street (Utsav Hotel
and Resorts, Burhanpur); the street is Raver Road per the client (listings say Bahadarpur Road).
label is the button copy.

hints.reception: Tap to light up the night
